name: tubeless
description: Summarize a YouTube video's transcript with an LLM, powered by the tubeless CLI

interface.longDescription: Fetch a YouTube video's transcript and summarize it into a TL;DR and key points via the tubeless CLI. Backends: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini (free tier), or a local Ollama model.
